title: enneastemon mannii
intro: Enneastemon mannii, commonly known as African bitter leaf, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include acting as an antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory agent, and has been used traditionally to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Enneastemon mannii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
